rules.value: base10 = 625 + 42*L + 2*L^2 (i.e. 62.5 + 4.2*L + 0.2*L^2), L = creature level; gained = floor(base10 * streakMod / 10); baseGained = floor(base10 / 10)
rules.reasoning: Two coefficients fit ten integer constraints across levels 1-9, including four streak-doubled values that only fit if the modifier is applied before truncation. Valid range observed: creature levels 1-9 with player levels 2-10; higher levels are an extrapolation.

rules.value: 5 * L credits at the kill, announced by GotLoot with no items
citations: A3-081 and B1-018: the credit line arrives with the experience line, not at corpse looting

rules.value: the streak rises one step per 3 kills (solo), streakMod = 1 + step
citations: A4: kills at 391.5 and 396.1 plain, 401.5 max streak (+100%)
levels 2, 3, 5 and 8 reach 'max kill streak' at +100% (A4-10, B1-041, B3-028, B3-035); level 10 shows +100% (B3-060)

rules.value: 1 prestige point, PM 10000134, once per streak when the max step is reached, before the experience line

citations: A4-18 streak kill 12.5 s after A4-16
A4-28 plain kill 16.1 s after A4-18
rules.reasoning: bounded to (12.5, 16.1] s by final-week footage; 15 s chosen inside the bound

rules.value: squad of n (1-6): share% = 100 - 8*(n-1); groupMod = n * share% / 100 (1.84, 2.52, 3.04, 3.40, 3.60); each member's baseGained = floor(base10 / (10 n)), the even split, and gained = that split times the modifiers, so gained is share% of the solo experience
citations: manifestation Recv_ExperienceChanged: '[base]' and '(+groupMod% Group Bonus)' printed when groupMod > 1, so baseGained is the split and groupMod the bonus over it
TaRapedia Experience 2008-10-06: base / members * multiplier, table 84/154/204/240/260
rules.reasoning: The client computes exactly this number for the XP-bar tooltip, and the chat line only reads coherently (gained = base x groupMod) if baseGained is the even split. TaRapedia agrees for 2, 4, 5 and 6 members and with its 4-member example; its 3-member +154% (2540) is 2 points above the client's 152 (2520) and is taken as a transcription slip. groupMod is sent at full precision: narrowed to single precision 2.52 and 3.04 would print 151 and 203.

rules.value: the killer and every squadmate on the same map channel within 100 m (MIN_DISTANCE_FOR_KILL_CREDIT) of the creature when it dies; n counts every squad member in the world, wherever they are
citations: TaRapedia Experience 2008-10-06: 'so long as you are in range when it is killed, even if you have not dealt any damage to it'
gameconstants MIN_DISTANCE_FOR_KILL_CREDIT 100 (line 333, offset 1376), never read by the client
experiencebarwindow: partySize = len(GetSquadMembers()) + 1, every squadmate the server announced in the world
rules.reasoning: The range is the one kill-credit distance the client defines; its use here is from its name. n follows the client's tooltip, which counts announced squadmates without regard to distance, so a member out of range lowers the others' share as it lowers the tooltip's bonus. Neither the range test nor the size rule is in the client (GAP-XP-SQUAD-RANGE).
rules.uncertainty: whether the 100 m is measured from the creature or the killer, whether dead members share, and whether absent members count toward n

rules.value: d = player level - creature level; kept% = 100 for d <= 5, 100 - 20*(d - 5) for 5 < d <= 9 (80, 60, 40, 20), 0 for d >= 10; applied to each recipient with their own level; an experience line of 0 is not sent
citations: gameconstants LEVELDIFF_DAMAGEMOD_LEVEL_MIN 9 / MAX 12 / MODIFIER 0.9/(MAX-MIN) (lines 110-112): the same module's other level-difference ramp, zero at its MIN and stepping per level to its MAX
TaRapedia Experience 2008-10-06: 'If a player is ten or more levels above a monster, no experience will be earned'
B3-047 (8VXeKzGUv0c, 315.6 s and 326.2 s): a level-8 player gains the full level-7 base 101 twice
rules.reasoning: The constants are original; the client never reads them, so the shape is reconstructed. Stepping DANGER_PENALTY_VALUE per level from MIN to MAX, as LEVELDIFF_DAMAGEMOD steps from its MIN to its MAX, leaves 20% at 9 levels and makes 10+ the first level with nothing, which is TaRapedia's rule. The alternative reading, the first 20% lost at 5, reaches 0% at 9 and contradicts it. TaRapedia's 'full at or below, decreasing for every level above' is contradicted by B3-047 (full at +1) and by the constant's minimum of 5; its 'exponentially' is not modelled.
rules.uncertainty: no final-era kill with the player 5 or more levels above the creature is recorded; every observed kill is at d <= 1

rules.value: a crit kill (finishing blow on an overkilled creature) pays two kill chunks, the first flagged wasCritKill, each computed as a plain kill with the streak advanced once per chunk; one credit payment after both
citations: B1-028 (8VXeKzGUv0c, 47.2 s, final week): 'You gained 66 experience points by Crit Killing. / You gained 66 experience points. / You received 5 credits.' at a level-1 creature
C1-015 (pre-D16.5 corroboration): a separate 'by Crit Killing' line equal to the base
TaRapedia Experience 2008-10-06: double experience; 'counts as two kills in a chain ... one chunk of experience at one level (eg. 2x) and another chunk at the next (3x)'
rules.reasoning: The amounts and order are read from the final-week chat; the streak accounting is TaRapedia's. Nothing raises a crit kill yet: overkill, CRIT_PREDEATH_EFFECT and RequestCritDeathFinish are not implemented (GAP-CRIT-DEATH-FINISH). Team crit kills (PM 1135) are left out.

rules.value: gained = floor(base10 * streakMod / (10 n)); then floor(gained * n * share% / 100) when n > 1; then floor(gained * kept% / 100) when kept% < 100
citations: the solo streak fit (xp.base): the streak multiplies the unrounded base
rules.reasoning: The fit fixes only that nothing truncates the base before the streak. The group bonus applied first, or to the unrounded split, pays a few points more; the danger penalty's place is equally unevidenced (GAP-XP-MODIFIER-ORDER).

unexplained.summary: Re-read 2026-09-26. The frame shows '...Streak Bonus] / You received 40 credits. / You gained 101 experience points. [101 Base XP] [+100% Kill Streak Bonus]'. Every final-week reward prints the experience line before its credit line (A3-081, B1-018, B1-028), so the 40 credits belong to the cut-off line above, not to the 101 line; the earlier reading as a level-difference reduction of a level-8 base does not hold. The 101 line gains exactly its base under a +100% streak: a factor 0.5 after the streak on a level-7 base (floor(1017 * 2 * 0.5 / 10) = 101). The player is level 10, three above a level-7 creature, below DANGER_PENALTY_LEVELDIFF_MIN, so it is not the danger penalty. It fits KC_2ND_PLACE_MOD 0.5 (partial credit, GAP-XP-PARTIAL). Not modelled.

The cut after the Tizzik Gi objective contains both 143 XP / 50 credits and 71 XP / 10 credits. The boss kill is not shown. A 1.15 hidden type multiplier applied before truncation to the fitted level-10 base 124.5 gives 143, but pair attribution, multiplier and reward order remain unverified; see bootcamp-tizzik-xp-source-reconciliation-20260924.json.

Plain 17, 33 and 35 experience with no credits: floor(717 * 0.25 / 10) = 17, floor(669 * 0.5 / 10) = 33 and floor(717 * 0.5 / 10) = 35, i.e. the client's KC_3RD_PLACE_MOD 0.25 and KC_2ND_PLACE_MOD 0.5 applied to the level 1/2 base before truncation, where allied NPCs did most of the damage. That points to damage-ranked partial credit (KC_1ST/2ND/3RD_PLACE_MOD 1.0/0.5/0.25, KC_MINIMUM_PERCENTAGE_DONE 0.15, KC_HEAL_FACTOR 1.75); the ranking and who counts in it are not in the client (GAP-XP-PARTIAL). Not modelled.
Crit kills add a separate 'by Crit Killing' line equal to the base. Modelled by xp.crit; the trigger (overkill and the finishing blow) is not (GAP-CRIT-DEATH-FINISH).
Pre-D16.5: a streak-annotated line whose gain equals its base. Not reproduced.

gaps.summary: The danger penalty's constants are original but the client never reads them; the linear ramp 100/80/60/40/20/0 for 5/6/7/8/9/10+ levels above is inferred (xp.danger). No recorded final-era kill has the player 5 or more levels above the creature. Closes with such an observation or the original server code.

Who shares a squad kill: the 100 m range (MIN_DISTANCE_FOR_KILL_CREDIT, from its name), measured from the creature, counting dead members, and n counting every squad member in the world are inferred (xp.group.recipients).
STREAK_BASE_PER_PARTY_MEMBER 3 suggests a squad streak needing 3 kills per member per step; the server keeps the solo streak for the killer and pays squadmates without a streak.

Damage-ranked partial credit: KC_1ST/2ND/3RD_PLACE_MOD 1.0/0.5/0.25, KC_MINIMUM_PERCENTAGE_DONE 0.15 and KC_HEAL_FACTOR 1.75 (gameconstants lines 99-107) fit the plain half and quarter lines B1-025/032/033 and the halved streak line B3-060, but how damage is ranked, whether NPC allies and squads count as one, and whether credits follow are not in the client. The creature keeps no per-attacker damage. Only the killing blow (and its squad) is credited.

The crit-kill reward is modelled but nothing triggers it: overkill, IsOverkillable/CRIT_PREDEATH_EFFECT, RequestCritDeathFinish (opcode 662, action 10000002) and CRIT_DEATH_EFFECT are not implemented, and team crit kills (wasTeamCritKill, PM 1135) are not paid.
The order in which the streak, group and danger modifiers truncate is inferred beyond the solo streak fit (xp.modifier_order).
Kill credits stay 5 x creature level to the killer alone: whether squadmates, the danger penalty or partial credit change them is unrecorded (B1-025-style partial lines show no credits).
Corpse items remain the emulator placeholder roll.
